protocol: Phase II and Phase III protocols supplied privately
crf: Phase II and Phase III CRFs supplied privately
adam_directories: Phase II ADaM package supplied privately
other_data: Supplementary Phase II data supplied privately

design.success_rule: Upper bound of the 95% Miettinen-Nurminen confidence interval for risk difference (test minus control) is below 0
design.multiplicity: single protocol-defined primary endpoint; confirm in SAP
design.primary_analysis: center-adjusted CMH test with Miettinen-Nurminen risk-difference confidence interval

primary_endpoint.name: BV recurrence within 90 days
primary_endpoint.analysis_population: protocol-defined FAS: randomized, treated, post-treatment data available, and cured at D21 plus or minus 3 days
primary_endpoint.missing_rule: Missing D104 without previously observed recurrence is counted as recurrence
primary_endpoint.intercurrent_event_strategy: treatment policy for poor adherence, prohibited therapy, and other relevant reproductive infection; composite for missing D104
primary_endpoint.success_criterion: one-sided alpha 0.025 and upper 95% confidence limit for test-minus-control risk difference below 0

candidate_endpoints.name: Time from cure to first BV recurrence
candidate_endpoints.timepoint: through D104 plus or minus 5 days

feedback.email_delivery: background outbox using environment-provided SMTP credentials
feedback.automatic_receipt: sent only when contact email is provided and SMTP succeeds
feedback.attachments: up to 3 verified PNG/JPEG files, 5 MB each

governance.phase3_ongoing_data_use: canonical blinded current cut permitted only for aggregate early consistency; never model training, variable selection, or tuning
governance.unblinded_derivatives: not permitted for confirmatory planning evidence

recurrence_scenario_engine.target: D104 recurrence conditional on protocol-defined D21 cure
recurrence_scenario_engine.source_target_proxy: observed D104 recurrence among Phase II D24 cured participants
recurrence_scenario_engine.method: strongly regularized Bayesian logistic scenario model
recurrence_scenario_engine.intended_use: exploratory planning and directional hypothesis generation
unsupported_uses: patient ranking or high-medium-low risk classification
Phase III probability of success or Bayesian assurance
Actual randomized treatment-arm input or display
Using ongoing Phase III outcomes for training, variable selection, or tuning

performance.interpretation: weak internal validation; not suitable for individual prediction or ranking

recurrence_scenario_engine.hypothetical_arm_output: simultaneous test and control regimen scenarios plus draw-wise test-minus-control; never actual randomized arm or individual treatment effect
